issues.legal_issue: A special appeal cannot be dismissed summarily on locus standi when material questions requiring determination remain unresolved.
material_facts: The landowners had obtained a final ejectment decree that was binding on the occupant.

In later consolidation proceedings, authorities disagreed about whether the occupant had been recorded as an occupant on the relevant date and whether the landowners were deemed to hold the land as khudkast.

The High Court’s single judge held that the landowners had no subsisting rights after vesting, and the Division Bench dismissed their special appeal summarily without fully considering the necessary questions.
issues.conclusion: The Division Bench erred in dismissing the special appeal summarily. The matter was remitted to the High Court with a direction to admit the appeal, hear it, and decide all necessary points in accordance with law. The Supreme Court did not finally decide the substantive questions concerning the landowners’ or occupant’s rights.
issues.legal_principle: Where a special appeal raises material questions requiring determination, summary dismissal without considering those questions is erroneous. The questions requiring consideration included the effect of the final ejectment decree; whether the occupant had been recorded as an occupant for Section 20(b) of the U.P. Zamindari Abolition and Land Reforms Act; and the meaning of land deemed under Section 18(1)(a) to be held by an intermediary as khudkast. The court noted that Upper Ganges Sugar Mills Ltd. v. Khalil-ul-Rahman could not assist the occupant if he had not been recorded as an occupant on the relevant date. It left the substantive questions for the High Court to decide.

predicates.appeal_from_writ_dismissal: The proceeding is a special appeal from the dismissal of a writ petition.
predicates.material_questions_unresolved: Material factual or legal questions bearing on the parties’ rights remain unresolved.
predicates.dismissed_without_considering_questions: The appellate court dismisses the special appeal without considering those material questions.
predicates.special_appeal_must_be_heard_and_materia: The special appeal must be heard and the material questions must be decided.

issues.definition: When a special appeal from a writ dismissal presents unresolved material questions and is dismissed without their consideration, the appeal must be heard and those questions decided.
